setting: Present-day Pune. A small rented study. Desk at the east wall, door west, two chairs south of the desk. Warm afternoon window light.
premise: Mira is packing to leave after a rejected grant. Her brother Dev has hidden the approval letter because he fears being left alone.
central_conflict: Dev must choose between keeping Mira close and giving her the opportunity he withheld.
ending_constraints: Mira gets the letter and key. She leaves the room with a choice, not instant forgiveness.
visual_style: Grounded live-action drama, natural skin and window light, restrained camera movement.

relationships.description: Adult siblings who share rent. Affection strained by Dev making decisions for Mira.

environments.description: Small study with desk east, door west, two chairs south, window north.

characters.name: Mira
characters.description: Adult woman, short dark hair, blue cotton shirt, canvas bag.
characters.goal: Find out why her grant was rejected and leave before the next rent payment.

characters.name: Dev
characters.description: Adult man, cropped dark hair, grey shirt with rolled sleeves.
characters.goal: Keep his sister nearby without admitting he needs her help.
